_note: Grounding test set for the launch language en. 20 answerable + 10 unanswerable questions, mirroring the cnr set so the two launch languages are compared on the same facts. The expected answers were prepared independently from the retrieval pipeline, by reading the seed facts (seed_data/heritage_entries.json) and the public sources cited there; they are the reference a human uses when checking the run, never an input to the assistant. 'expected_slugs' lists the approved entries that may legitimately be cited. The unanswerable block contains (a) three questions whose answer exists ONLY in non-approved sample entries (draft golden bell 1687, reviewed old school 41 pupils, rejected Roman villa 1999), (b) two questions about Gornji Stoliv, seeded as an unverified draft, and (c) five off-topic questions outside the territory and the mandate of the assistant.

questions.question: From which century is the church of St Mary in Gornja Lastva?
questions.expected_answer: The church of St Mary in Gornja Lastva dates from the 14th century.

questions.question: From which century is the church of St Vitus above Gornja Lastva?
questions.expected_answer: The church of St Vitus is from the 9th century.

questions.question: At what altitude does the church of St Vitus stand?
questions.expected_answer: At 440 metres above sea level.

questions.question: On which day is the Lastovska fešta held?
questions.expected_answer: Every first Saturday of August.

questions.question: Since which year has the Lastovska fešta been held?
questions.expected_answer: Since 1974.

questions.question: When will the 53rd Lastovska fešta take place?
questions.expected_answer: On Saturday, 7 August 2027.

questions.question: Since which year have the Landscape Days been held?
questions.expected_answer: Since 2015.

questions.question: What is the name of the culture house in Gornja Lastva?
questions.expected_answer: The culture house "Ilija Marković".

questions.question: Until which year did the olive mills operate in Gornja Lastva?
questions.expected_answer: Until 1945.

questions.question: How many permanent residents did Gornja Lastva have in the 2011 census?
questions.expected_answer: None: the 2011 census recorded no resident population in Gornja Lastva.

questions.question: Where is Gornja Lastva located?
questions.expected_answer: On the slopes of the Vrmac hill, above Donja Lastva and the town of Tivat in the Bay of Kotor.

questions.question: Which municipality do Gornja and Donja Lastva belong to?
questions.expected_answer: The municipality of Tivat.

questions.question: What is Donja Lastva and where is it?
questions.expected_answer: A settlement on the shore of the Bay of Tivat, north-west of the centre of Tivat, below Gornja Lastva.

questions.question: What is Tivat?
questions.expected_answer: A town on the Bay of Tivat in the Bay of Kotor and the seat of the municipality of the same name.
questions.note: Tivat as town and municipal seat.

questions.question: Between which bays does the hill of Vrmac lie?
questions.expected_answer: Between the Bay of Tivat and the Bay of Kotor.

questions.question: Is there a footpath from Donja Lastva up to Gornja Lastva?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, a footpath leads uphill from Donja Lastva to Gornja Lastva.

questions.question: Which churches does the village of Gornja Lastva have?
questions.expected_answer: The church of St Mary from the 14th century and the church of St Vitus from the 9th century at 440 metres.

questions.question: What are the Landscape Days dedicated to?
questions.expected_answer: To the cultural landscape of Vrmac and Gornja Lastva, and to the protection and revival of heritage and landscape.

questions.question: What takes place in the culture house Ilija Marković?
questions.expected_answer: Exhibitions, lectures, workshops and community meetings, including programmes of the Landscape Days.

questions.question: How is the church of St Vitus reached from the village?
questions.expected_answer: By a footpath from Gornja Lastva up the hill to the church at 440 metres.
